# Season checklist

The whole year on one page. Details for each item are in the earlier
chapters. "Update the Sheet" always means: edit the conference Google
Sheet, run `source("conferences/_update-conference.R")`, then render the
conference pages.

## Before the season

- [ ] Get a copy of the website folder from the web editor
- [ ] Install Quarto, R, and RStudio
- [ ] Preview the site locally once, so you know the tooling works
- [ ] Make sure you can edit the conference Google Sheet

## After the previous conference (rollover)

- [ ] Archive the old year into `conferences/archive/` (include `data/`)
- [ ] Copy `conferences/_template/` into `conferences/`
- [ ] Replace every placeholder, in the pages and in `data/*.csv`
- [ ] Add `images/logo.png` and `images/hotel.png`
- [ ] Update the year in the Conferences menu in `_quarto.yml`
- [ ] Update the Sheet for the new year and run the update script
- [ ] Render the conference pages and hand off to the web editor

## Fall

- [ ] Set the CFP keys in the Sheet, then open up the full call in
      `cfp/index.qmd` (Stage 2)
- [ ] Add workshop rows to the Sheet as workshops are confirmed
- [ ] Set `sort-ui` and `filter-ui` on the preconference page once the
      first workshop is up
- [ ] Set `hotel_note` and `hotel_booking_url` when the room block opens
      (Stage 3)

## Winter

- [ ] Set `schedule_note` when the program is ready (Stage 4)
- [ ] Set `registration_note` and `registration_url`, and fill in the
      rates tabs (Stage 5)

## After your conference

- [ ] Send the web editor any final program PDFs for the archive
- [ ] Hand the website folder, the Google Sheet, this guide, and your
      notes to next year's co-chairs

## Where to get help

- Mechanics of editing and previewing: `UPDATING.md` in the project root
- The yearly rollover: `conferences/_template/README.md`
- The Sheet structure: header comments of
  `conferences/_update-conference.R`
- Anything stuck or broken: the web editor, webeditor@ap-ls.org
